question:
**Direction:** The following pie chart shows the percentage distribution of the total number of students selected in an entrance exam from six different schools (A, B, C, D, E and F) in year 2020.

Total number of students selected from all six schools in 2020 = 3200

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f8e2fd2ea43ab4acb17448c803d7897c099c757955d01886ce7363a6902e4a.png] 

What is the central angle formed by the number of students selected in exam from school C, E and F together?
solution:
Percentage of students selected in exam from school C, E and F together = 22% + 13% + 11% = 46%

⇒ Angle = (46/100) × 360° = 165.6°
